meta.title: Oxford 3000 / 5000 with word forms and one example sentence per entry

items.ar: الملف فيه 5325 مدخلة من قائمة Oxford 3000 / Oxford 5000. كل مدخلة تحتفظ بحقولها الأصلية كما هي (id, word, pos, level, list, sense) وتُضاف لها حقول جديدة: التصنيفات (categories) والتصريفات حسب نوع الكلمة.
items.en: This file has 5,325 entries from the Oxford 3000 / Oxford 5000 lists. Every entry keeps its original fields unchanged (id, word, pos, level, list, sense) and gets new fields: categories and the word forms that match its category.

items.ar: الكلمة التي لا تتغير (حرف جر، حرف عطف، ضمير، أداة تعريف...) ليس لها كائن تصريفات، وقيمة has_changing_forms فيها false.
items.en: A word that does not change (preposition, conjunction, pronoun, article...) has no forms object and has_changing_forms = false.

items.ar: الكلمة الواحدة قد تظهر في أكثر من صف لأن Oxford يفصل بين المعاني/التصنيفات (مثلاً like كفعل وlike كحرف جر). كل صف له تصريفاته الخاصة حسب تصنيفه.
items.en: The same word can appear in several rows because Oxford separates senses/categories (e.g. like as a verb and like as a preposition). Each row has its own forms according to its own category.

title.en: How an AI agent should read an entry

items.ar: الخطوة 1: اقرأ categories لمعرفة تصنيف الكلمة (noun, verb, adjective, adverb...). قد يكون للكلمة أكثر من تصنيف مثل noun + verb.
items.en: Step 1: read categories to know the word class (noun, verb, adjective, adverb...). A word may have more than one, e.g. noun + verb.

items.ar: الخطوة 2: لكل تصنيف ابحث عن الكائن المقابل: verb_forms للفعل، noun_forms للاسم، adjective_forms للصفة، adverb_forms للظرف، modal_forms للأفعال المساعدة الناقصة، derived_forms للكلمات المشتقة من نفس العائلة.
items.en: Step 2: for each category look for the matching object: verb_forms, noun_forms, adjective_forms, adverb_forms, modal_forms, and derived_forms for related words of the same family.

items.ar: الخطوة 3: لمعرفة حالة كلمة موجودة في جملة، قارنها بقيم الكائن. مثال: لو ظهرت took فهي V2 (التصريف الثاني) للفعل take، ولو ظهرت taken فهي V3 (التصريف الثالث).
items.en: Step 3: to find out which form a word in a sentence is, compare it with the values of the object. Example: took = V2 of take, taken = V3 of take.

items.ar: إذا تطابقت قيمتان (مثل cut / cut / cut) فالسياق هو الحكم: بعد have / has / had أو بعد be في المبني للمجهول = V3، وفي الماضي البسيط (yesterday, last year, ago) = V2، وبعد he / she / it في المضارع = V1 + s.
items.en: If two values are identical (cut / cut / cut) the context decides: after have / has / had, or after be in the passive = V3; simple past with a time word (yesterday, last year, ago) = V2; he / she / it in the present = V1 + s.

title.ar: الأفعال (verb_forms): ما معنى كل تصريف ومتى يُستخدم
title.en: Verbs (verb_forms): what each form means and when it is used

items.ar: V1_base = التصريف الأول (الصيغة الأصلية بدون to). يُستخدم: (1) المضارع البسيط مع I / you / we / they: I take. (2) بعد الأفعال المساعدة do / does / did / will / can / must / should: She can take it. (3) الأمر: Take it! (4) مع to في المصدر: I want to take it.
items.en: V1_base = first form (base form, without to). Used: (1) present simple with I / you / we / they: I take. (2) after do / does / did / will / can / must / should: She can take it. (3) imperative: Take it! (4) with to as the infinitive: I want to take it.

items.ar: V2_past_simple = التصريف الثاني (الماضي البسيط). يُستخدم لحدث بدأ وانتهى في الماضي، غالباً مع كلمة وقت: I took the bus yesterday. لا يحتاج فعلاً مساعداً في الإثبات.
items.en: V2_past_simple = second form (past simple). Used for an action that started and finished in the past, often with a time word: I took the bus yesterday. No auxiliary verb is needed in positive sentences.

items.ar: V3_past_participle = التصريف الثالث (اسم المفعول). يُستخدم: (1) مع have / has / had في الأزمنة التامة: I have taken it, she had taken it. (2) مع be في المبني للمجهول: it was taken. (3) كصفة: a broken window, a closed door.
items.en: V3_past_participle = third form (past participle). Used: (1) with have / has / had in perfect tenses: I have taken it, she had taken it. (2) with be in the passive: it was taken. (3) as an adjective: a broken window, a closed door.

items.ar: ING_present_participle = صيغة ing. تُستخدم: (1) في الأزمنة المستمرة مع be: I am taking, they were taking. (2) كاسم فعلي (gerund): Taking notes helps. (3) بعد حروف الجر: before taking. (4) بعد بعض الأفعال: enjoy taking, avoid taking. (5) كصفة: a boring film.
items.en: ING_present_participle = the -ing form. Used: (1) in continuous tenses with be: I am taking, they were taking. (2) as a gerund: Taking notes helps. (3) after prepositions: before taking. (4) after some verbs: enjoy taking, avoid taking. (5) as an adjective: a boring film.

items.ar: S_third_person_singular = صيغة s. تُستخدم فقط في المضارع البسيط مع he / she / it والمفرد الغائب: She takes. الإملاء: +s (takes)، +es بعد s / sh / ch / x / z / o (watches, goes)، حرف ساكن + y تتحول إلى ies (studies)، حرف علة + y تبقى y + s (plays).
items.en: S_third_person_singular = the -s form. Used only in the present simple with he / she / it and singular subjects: She takes. Spelling: +s (takes); +es after s / sh / ch / x / z / o (watches, goes); consonant + y becomes ies (studies); vowel + y stays y + s (plays).

items.ar: type = regular: الفعل منتظم، فـ V2 = V3 = V1 + ed. الإملاء: ينتهي بـ e فنضيف d فقط (like → liked)؛ ساكن + y تتحول إلى ied (study → studied)؛ مقطع واحد ينتهي بـ ساكن-علة-ساكن نكرر الحرف الأخير (stop → stopped)؛ غير ذلك نضيف ed (visit → visited).
items.en: type = regular: the verb is regular, so V2 = V3 = V1 + ed. Spelling: ends in e, add only d (like → liked); consonant + y becomes ied (study → studied); one-syllable consonant-vowel-consonant verbs double the last letter (stop → stopped); otherwise add ed (visit → visited).

items.ar: type = irregular: الفعل شاذ، فـ V2 و V3 تُحفظ ولا تُشتق بقاعدة. الأنماط الأربعة: A-A-A كلها متطابقة (cut cut cut)، A-B-B الثاني والثالث متطابقان (buy bought bought)، A-B-C الثلاثة مختلفة (take took taken)، A-B-A الأول والثالث متطابقان (come came come).
items.en: type = irregular: the verb is irregular, so V2 and V3 must be memorised, not derived by a rule. Four patterns: A-A-A all identical (cut cut cut), A-B-B second and third identical (buy bought bought), A-B-C all different (take took taken), A-B-A first and third identical (come came come).

items.ar: V2_alternatives و V3_alternatives (إن وُجدت) هي صيغ بديلة صحيحة، غالباً فرق بين البريطاني والأمريكي أو فرق بالمعنى، مثل learned / learnt وgot / gotten وlie: lay (يستلقي) مقابل lied (يكذب).
items.en: V2_alternatives and V3_alternatives (when present) are other correct forms, usually British / American differences or a difference in meaning, e.g. learned / learnt, got / gotten, lie: lay (recline) vs lied (tell a lie).

items.ar: إملاء ing: نحذف e الصامتة (make → making)، ie تتحول إلى ying (die → dying)، نكرر الحرف الأخير في نمط ساكن-علة-ساكن بمقطع واحد (run → running)، وغير ذلك نضيف ing مباشرة (play → playing).
items.en: -ing spelling: drop silent e (make → making); ie becomes ying (die → dying); double the last letter in one-syllable consonant-vowel-consonant verbs (run → running); otherwise just add ing (play → playing).

items.ar: الفعل be له شكل خاص: am / is / are في المضارع، وwas / were في الماضي، وbeen = V3، وbeing = ING. الفعلان have وdo أيضاً شاذان (has / had / had / having) و (does / did / done / doing).
items.en: The verb be is special: am / is / are in the present, was / were in the past, been = V3, being = ING. Have and do are also irregular (has / had / had / having) and (does / did / done / doing).

items.ar: modal_forms: الأفعال الناقصة (can, could, may, might, must, shall, should, will, would, ought, need, used to...) ليس لها s ولا ing ولا V3، ويأتي بعدها الفعل بصيغة V1 مباشرة (She can swim). إن وُجد V2_past_form فهو الشكل الماضي المقابل (can → could, will → would). أما have to فتتصرف كفعل عادي: has to / had to / having to.
items.en: modal_forms: modal verbs (can, could, may, might, must, shall, should, will, would, ought, need, used to...) have no -s, no -ing and no V3, and are followed directly by V1 (She can swim). V2_past_form, if present, is the matching past form (can → could, will → would). Have to behaves like a normal verb: has to / had to / having to.

items.ar: singular = المفرد، plural = الجمع. الجمع يُستخدم عندما يكون العدد أكثر من واحد: one book, two books. إذا كانت قيمة plural تساوي null فالاسم لا يُجمع.
items.en: singular = the singular form, plural = the plural form. The plural is used when there is more than one: one book, two books. If plural is null the noun has no plural.

items.ar: قواعد الجمع المنتظم: +s (books)، +es بعد s / x / z / ch / sh وبعض كلمات o (boxes, heroes)، ساكن + y تتحول إلى ies (city → cities)، حرف علة + y نضيف s فقط (day → days)، وبعض كلمات f / fe تتحول إلى ves (knife → knives, leaf → leaves).
items.en: Regular plural rules: +s (books); +es after s / x / z / ch / sh and some -o words (boxes, heroes); consonant + y becomes ies (city → cities); vowel + y just adds s (day → days); some f / fe words change to ves (knife → knives, leaf → leaves).

items.ar: الجمع الشاذ يُحفظ: man → men, woman → women, child → children, person → people, foot → feet, tooth → teeth, mouse → mice، وجموع الكلمات اللاتينية واليونانية: analysis → analyses, criterion → criteria, phenomenon → phenomena.
items.en: Irregular plurals are memorised: man → men, woman → women, child → children, person → people, foot → feet, tooth → teeth, mouse → mice, and Latin / Greek plurals: analysis → analyses, criterion → criteria, phenomenon → phenomena.

items.ar: حقل note يوضح الحالات الخاصة: uncountable (no plural) = اسم غير معدود لا يُجمع (information, advice, furniture)؛ same form for singular and plural = المفرد والجمع نفس الشكل (sheep, series)؛ plural-only = اسم يأتي بصيغة الجمع فقط (clothes, trousers)؛ no plural = لا جمع له.
items.en: The note field explains special cases: uncountable (no plural) = cannot be pluralised (information, advice, furniture); same form for singular and plural (sheep, series); plural-only form (clothes, trousers); no plural.

items.ar: gradable = true تعني أن الصفة تقبل المقارنة والتفضيل. gradable = false تعني أنها لا تُقارن عادة (مثل dead, final, daily, nuclear, main) ولذلك لا يوجد لها comparative / superlative.
items.en: gradable = true means the adjective can be compared. gradable = false means it is normally not compared (dead, final, daily, nuclear, main), so it has no comparative / superlative.

items.ar: comparative = صيغة المقارنة بين شيئين، وتُستخدم مع than: She is taller than him / This is more interesting than that.
items.en: comparative = comparison between two things, used with than: She is taller than him / This is more interesting than that.

items.ar: superlative = صيغة التفضيل لأعلى درجة بين ثلاثة أشياء فأكثر، وتأتي مع the: the tallest, the most interesting.
items.en: superlative = the highest degree among three or more things, used with the: the tallest, the most interesting.

items.ar: القاعدة: صفة من مقطع واحد تأخذ er / est (tall → taller → tallest)، وإذا انتهت بـ e نضيف r / st فقط (nice → nicer)، وبنمط ساكن-علة-ساكن نكرر الحرف (big → bigger)، وساكن + y تتحول إلى ier / iest (happy → happier). الصفة من مقطعين تنتهي بـ y تأخذ ier / iest. الصفات الأطول وأغلب ما ينتهي بـ ful / ous / ive / ing / ed تأخذ more / most (more beautiful, most interesting).
items.en: Rule: one-syllable adjectives take er / est (tall → taller → tallest); ending in e just add r / st (nice → nicer); consonant-vowel-consonant doubles the letter (big → bigger); consonant + y becomes ier / iest (happy → happier). Two-syllable adjectives ending in y take ier / iest. Longer adjectives and most ending in ful / ous / ive / ing / ed take more / most (more beautiful, most interesting).

items.ar: الصفات الشاذة: good → better → best، bad → worse → worst، far → farther / further، little → less → least، old → older / elder. عندما تظهر صيغتان مفصولتان بـ / فكلاهما صحيح (quieter / more quiet).
items.en: Irregular adjectives: good → better → best, bad → worse → worst, far → farther / further, little → less → least, old → older / elder. When two forms are separated by / both are correct (quieter / more quiet).

items.ar: adverb = الظرف (الحال) المشتق من الصفة، غالباً بإضافة ly: quick → quickly. الإملاء: y تتحول إلى ily (happy → happily)، le تتحول إلى ly (simple → simply)، ic تتحول إلى ically (basic → basically)، ll تضيف y فقط (full → fully). حالات خاصة: good → well, public → publicly, true → truly, whole → wholly.
items.en: adverb = the adverb formed from the adjective, usually by adding ly: quick → quickly. Spelling: y becomes ily (happy → happily); le becomes ly (simple → simply); ic becomes ically (basic → basically); ll adds only y (full → fully). Special cases: good → well, public → publicly, true → truly, whole → wholly.

items.ar: adverb_note يظهر عندما يختلف معنى صيغة ly عن الصفة نفسها إذا استُخدمت كظرف: hard (بجهد) مقابل hardly (بالكاد)، late (متأخراً) مقابل lately (مؤخراً)، near مقابل nearly (تقريباً).
items.en: adverb_note appears when the -ly form has a different meaning from the same-form adverb: hard (with effort) vs hardly (barely), late (not on time) vs lately (recently), near vs nearly (almost).

items.ar: gradable = true تعني أن الظرف يقبل المقارنة. الظروف المنتهية بـ ly تأخذ more / most (more quickly, most carefully)، والظروف القصيرة التي تشبه الصفة تأخذ er / est (fast → faster → fastest, hard → harder, soon → sooner). الشاذة: well → better → best، badly → worse → worst، early → earlier، late → later، far → farther / further.
items.en: gradable = true means the adverb can be compared. Adverbs ending in ly take more / most (more quickly, most carefully); short adverbs that look like the adjective take er / est (fast → faster → fastest, hard → harder, soon → sooner). Irregular: well → better → best, badly → worse → worst, early → earlier, late → later, far → farther / further.

items.ar: gradable = false تعني أن الظرف لا يُقارن عادة (always, never, here, actually, yesterday).
items.en: gradable = false means the adverb is normally not compared (always, never, here, actually, yesterday).

items.ar: derived_forms قائمة بكلمات من نفس عائلة الكلمة، كل عنصر فيه: word (الكلمة المشتقة)، pos (تصنيفها)، suffix (اللاحقة المستخدمة). القيمة (root form) تعني أن الكلمة المذكورة هي الأصل الأقصر الذي اشتُقت منه الكلمة الحالية (مثلاً education ← educate).
items.en: derived_forms is a list of words from the same word family. Each item has: word (the related word), pos (its class), suffix (the suffix used). The value (root form) means the listed word is the shorter root the current word comes from (e.g. education ← educate).

items.ar: -tion / -sion / -ation / -ition / -ion: تصنع اسماً يدل على الفعل أو نتيجته (educate → education, decide → decision).
items.en: -tion / -sion / -ation / -ition / -ion: make a noun for the action or its result (educate → education, decide → decision).

items.ar: -ment: اسم للفعل أو نتيجته (develop → development). -ance / -ence / -ancy / -ency: اسم للحالة أو الفعل (important → importance). -ure / -age / -ery / -ary: لواحق أسماء متنوعة.
items.en: -ment: noun for the action or result (develop → development). -ance / -ence / -ancy / -ency: noun for a state or action (important → importance). -ure / -age / -ery / -ary: various noun endings.

items.ar: -ness و -ity: اسم للصفة أو الحالة (happy → happiness, possible → possibility). -ship و -hood و -dom: اسم لمكانة أو حالة أو مجموعة (friend → friendship, child → childhood). -ism: مذهب أو فكرة.
items.en: -ness and -ity: noun for a quality or state (happy → happiness, possible → possibility). -ship, -hood, -dom: noun for a position, state or group (friend → friendship, child → childhood). -ism: a belief or system.

items.ar: -er و -or و -ant و -ent و -ee: اسم للشخص أو الشيء الذي يقوم بالفعل (teach → teacher, visit → visitor). -ist و -ian: شخص بحرفة أو تخصص (cycle → cyclist).
items.en: -er, -or, -ant, -ent, -ee: noun for the person or thing that does the action (teach → teacher, visit → visitor). -ist, -ian: person with a skill or profession (cycle → cyclist).

items.ar: -able و -ible: صفة بمعنى يمكن أن (afford → affordable). -ive و -ative: صفة بمعنى له خاصية (create → creative). -ful: مليء بـ (use → useful). -less: بدون (care → careless). -ous: يتصف بـ (danger → dangerous). -al و -ial و -ical و -ic: صفة بمعنى متعلق بـ (education → educational). -y: صفة (sleep → sleepy). -ly: ظرف، أو صفة من اسم (world → worldly).
items.en: -able, -ible: adjective meaning can be done (afford → affordable). -ive, -ative: adjective meaning having a quality (create → creative). -ful: full of (use → useful). -less: without (care → careless). -ous: having the quality of (danger → dangerous). -al, -ial, -ical, -ic: adjective meaning related to (education → educational). -y: adjective (sleep → sleepy). -ly: adverb, or an adjective from a noun (world → worldly).

items.ar: -ize / -ise / -ify / -ate / -en: أفعال بمعنى يجعل أو يصبح (modern → modernize, simple → simplify).
items.en: -ize / -ise / -ify / -ate / -en: verbs meaning to make or become (modern → modernize, simple → simplify).

items.ar: (related form) تعني أن الكلمة من نفس العائلة لكنها لا تنتهي بلاحقة قياسية (union ← unite).
items.en: (related form) means the word is from the same family but does not end in a standard suffix (union ← unite).

items.ar: جميع التصريفات حُسبت بقواعد اللغة مع قوائم مراجَعة للشواذ، ثم راجعتها يدوياً للأفعال الشاذة والأسماء الشاذة. إملاء الأفعال الأساسية يميل للأمريكي (traveled)، والبريطاني يظهر في V2_alternatives / V3_alternatives (travelled).
items.en: All forms were built with spelling rules plus curated lists of exceptions, and the irregular verbs and irregular nouns were checked by hand. The main spelling of regular verbs leans American (traveled); the British one appears in V2_alternatives / V3_alternatives (travelled).

items.ar: قابلية الاسم للعدّ (uncountable) وقابلية الصفة للمقارنة (gradable) تعتمد على قوائم مصنّفة يدوياً للكلمات الشائعة؛ الكلمات التي لها استخدامان (مثل experience, paper, time) تُعامل كأسماء معدودة ولها جمع.
items.en: Noun countability (uncountable) and adjective gradability (gradable) come from hand-curated lists of common words; nouns with two uses (experience, paper, time) are treated as countable and have a plural.

items.ar: derived_forms مأخوذة من WordNet ومصفّاة بحيث تبقى الكلمات الشائعة فقط (حتى 8 كلمات لكل مدخلة)، فهي ليست قائمة شاملة، وتُحسب على مستوى الكلمة وليس على مستوى المعنى (sense).
items.en: derived_forms come from WordNet, filtered to common words only (up to 8 per entry), so they are not exhaustive, and they are computed per word rather than per sense.

items.ar: has_changing_forms = true تعني أن الكلمة لها شكل واحد على الأقل يختلف عن الأصل (فعل، اسم له جمع، صفة تُقارن...).
items.en: has_changing_forms = true means the word has at least one form that differs from the base (a verb, a noun with a plural, a comparable adjective...).

fields.id / word / pos / level / list / sense: original fields from the Oxford file, unchanged
fields.categories: word classes in English (noun, verb, adjective, adverb...)
fields.has_changing_forms: true if at least one form differs from the base word
fields.verb_forms: V1_base, V2_past_simple, V3_past_participle, ING_present_participle, S_third_person_singular, type (regular / irregular), optional V2_alternatives, V3_alternatives, note
fields.modal_forms: for modal verbs: no -s / -ing / V3; optional V2_past_form
fields.noun_forms: singular, plural (null if no plural), optional note
fields.adjective_forms: gradable, comparative, superlative, adverb (-ly form), optional adverb_note
fields.derived_forms: list of {word, pos, suffix} from the same word family
fields.forms_summary: one-line human readable summary of all forms of the entry

words.example: Tom thought that it would be a long war.
We need to know everything you know about Tom.
I hope you're aware nobody is above the law.
Do you think you could swim across this river?
Tom is all words and no action.
Swimming is my favourite activity on holiday.
Tom should have been an actor.
I hear that she is a famous actress.

words.forms_summary: V1 add · V2 added · V3 added · ING adding · S adds
words.example: I think you should add a bit more pepper.
By the way, what is your address?
That boy speaks as if he were an adult.
It's too bad that you didn't take my advice.

words.forms_summary: comparative: more afraid · superlative: most afraid
words.example: I'm afraid that I can't save you this time.
Will you look after my dog while I'm away?
I'm afraid that I'll be tied up all afternoon.
If Tom calls again, tell him that I'm busy.
I know Tom is a bit short for his age.
This is the book I bought three days ago.

words.forms_summary: V1 agree · V2 agreed · V3 agreed · ING agreeing · S agrees
words.example: I think that I agree with all of that.
They said that they need to get some air.
A taxi from the airport costs about thirty dollars.
We all know more than we think we know.
They say that they also want to do that.
You are just the same as you always were.

words.forms_summary: comparative: more amazing · superlative: most amazing · adverb: amazingly
words.example: I know that Tom is a pretty amazing cook.
